$comment: The $id base is a placeholder until round 46 (the documentation site); see element.schema.json.
title: Cytoscape.js elements
description: The `elements` input in the definition form, in each of the three shapes the library accepts: an array of element definitions, a `{ nodes, edges }` map, or a single definition. In the map form the bucket decides the group, so every definition in `edges` must name a source and a target. The columnar bulk form and the binary wire form are not JSON documents and have no schema here; the columnar form's schema is held until 4.x, with the wire format's experimental status.

map.description: The `{ nodes, edges }` map (v3's `cy.json().elements`). Either key may be omitted.
